_meta.description: Heart event #2 for npc_paige: The Late Night

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [Late evening. Paige and Jack research a blueprint together]

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: Cross-reference the technical specifications with appendix C.

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: The indexing system is chronological within each section.

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: ...I haven't worked with someone like this in years.

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: Wren used to help me catalogue. He had no patience for organization.

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: But he'd sit here all night if I asked. Just... keeping me company.

options.text: He sounds like a good man.
I'm happy to keep you company.

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: ...Yes. He was. Thank you for not changing the subject.
